# smart-base-docs

The reader-facing pages, and the landing page `/smart-base/` serves. Generated by `smart-base:pages` (`fhir-harness/scripts/gen-ig-pages.ts --summary`) from `fhir-artifact-index/index.json` plus this declaration: the index page opens with this instance's own description and every declared graph with its viewer (the `harness_details.html` include over `site.data.harness`), then the artefact index. WHY IT EXISTS: before it, smart-base declared no renderable graph, so `/smart-base/` published nothing and the navbar tile fell back to the library viewer -- `harness-tiles.ts` reported that as a finding. Owner, 2026-10-01 (#1767): "smart-base/ needs a landing page". NOTHING HERE IS AUTHORED; `smart-base:pages:check` is the gate. The banner names THIS IG (`smart.who.int.base`) from the index, not the IG the chrome was ingested from, and draws no status watermark because the chrome's status is smart-trust's (bean `bamf`).

Part of [SMART Base](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-base-docs`, holding `docs`.
